{{Quote|Well, there's one consolation. He can't possibly know where he is.''"<br />"''Why?''"<br />"''Because I don't have any idea where I am. That last jump tossed us right out of the nav computer.|Two crewmembers of a Rebel Alliance corvette, about the ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer|<ref name="TRG1" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an '''''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer''' of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at one point pursued a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Unidentified Alliance corvette|corvette]]. During the pursuit, which took both [[Starship/Legends|starships]] into unknown [[Realspace/Legends|space]], a [[fathership]] of an [[Unidentified galaxy (googly-eyed species)|extragalactic]] [[Unidentified googly-eyed species|species]] appeared and captured the two vessels. Their crewmembers were rendered unconscious and brought aboard the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] ship, where they were then forced to compete against each other in a series of contests. Ultimately, the Rebel crew emerged victorious, and the aliens declared the Imperial crew to be [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] to the victors. The Alliance personnel subsequently confined the Imperials and took the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] to familiar space and the Alliance headquarters.

==Description==
An [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] served as part of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="TRG1" /> Like other ''Imperial''-class [[Starship/Legends|vessels]], it was manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] and measured 1,600 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length.<ref name="DB" />

==History==
{{RPGseed}}
===Pursuit into the unknown===
{{Quote|No chance they can track us through hyperspace, eh?''"<br />"''It's not my fault! Just a lucky guess &mdash; could happen to anyone&hellip;|Two crewmembers of a Rebel Alliance corvette, about the ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer|<ref name="TRG1" />}}
[[File:ImpStarDestroyer-SWI125.jpg|thumb|right|300px|An ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer (one such starship pictured) once pursued a Rebel Alliance corvette into unknown space.]]
At one point during the Galactic Civil War, the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] discovered an [[Unidentified Alliance corvette|Alliance corvette]] aboard which a team of Rebel operatives served as guest crew and proceeded to pursue it. The [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] attempted to shake off its pursuer through a series of maneuvers, including a number of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jumps, but the Imperial [[Warship/Legends|warship]] remained on its tail.<ref name="TRG1" />

Ultimately, the Rebel vessel made a jump that took it into unknown territory. Nevertheless, the Star Destroyer also arrived at the corvette's location, making two of the pursued ship's crewmembers speculate on whether or not it had tracked them through hyperspace. While the Star Destroyer closed in on the corvette, one of the two Rebels also expressed their conviction that, since they were unaware of where their last jump had deposited them, the Imperial ship likewise found itself lost.<ref name="TRG1" />

===Captured contestants===
{{Quote|Beg pardon for interference in your sports contest. But. Here in ''[unintelligible]'' we greatly honor the principle of fairness in competition. Your contestants were so poorly matched as to spoil the enjoyment of your sport. We have endeavored to correct this oversight.|An alien aboard the fathership, to the crews of the Imperial Star Destroyer and the Rebel Alliance corvette|<ref name="TRG1" />}}
At that moment, a vast [[fathership]] of an [[Unidentified galaxy (googly-eyed species)|extragalactic]] [[Unidentified googly-eyed species|species]] materialized in front of the two vessels. It instantly captured both starships using [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] and sent out an Imperial [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]]-sized radiant vessel to each of the ships. Subsequently, [[alien droid]]s politely boarded both the Star Destroyer and the corvette and used beams of shimmering light to render their crew unconscious, after which they were taken aboard the fathership.<ref name="TRG1" />

There, the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] owners of the vessel forced the Imperial and Rebel crews to compete against each other in a series of non-violent contests. After the Rebels emerged victorious in the competition, the aliens declared the Imperials to be [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] to the victors, with the latter crew not being inclined to honor that judgment. The aliens subsequently returned the Rebel crew&mdash;along with the enslaved Imperials&mdash;to the two captured vessels, where the Imperial crew was then kept confined and under guard. The Rebel personnel went on to determine a course taking them back to familiar [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and took the captured Star Destroyer to Alliance headquarters. Due to that achievement, the Rebel operative team was later sent out on a difficult mission.<ref name="TRG1" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer appeared in "[[The Night Has a Thousand Eyes]]," a [[roleplaying game]] adventure idea included in the [[1987]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|rulebook]] for the first edition of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TRG1" />
